title: Orientation
description: auto lays the readouts out in one row when the source is wider than 1.6:1 and stacks them otherwise; the others force one arrangement. Size the source to suit (default 840×112 in a row, about 320×300 stacked).

title: Alignment
description: In a row: which edge the readouts hug when the source is wider than they need. Stacked: right puts UR and pp on the right edge, left on the left.

title: Backing
description: none floats the numbers on the game; scrim adds a soft dark fade inside the source; panel draws a graphite panel.

title: Accent
description: map tints the highlight (UR, mean marker, pp gap) with a colour derived from the beatmap background; 18-lab keeps the amber accent. Judgement and early/late colours never change.

title: Show hit-error histogram
description: Timing histogram and early/late split. UR and mean stay when it is off. osu!catch has no timing, so only pp shows there.

title: Show pp and if-FC
description: pp of the score and, when combo was lost, the pp a full combo would have given and the gap. osu!stable's results screen shows no pp.

title: Hold duration / s
description: Seconds it stays up after the results screen opens. 0 keeps it up for as long as the results screen is open.
